mapper.insert: INSERT INTO toilet_feedback (toilet_name, area, cleanliness_score, queue_score, odor_score, comment, visited_at, created_at) VALUES (#{toiletName}, #{area}, #{cleanlinessScore}, #{queueScore}, #{odorScore}, #{comment}, #{visitedAt}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, toilet_name AS toiletName, area, cleanliness_score AS cleanlinessScore, queue_score AS queueScore, odor_score AS odorScore, comment, visited_at AS visitedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM toilet_feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(cleanliness_score), 2) AS avgCleanliness, ROUND(AVG(queue_score), 2) AS avgQueue, ROUND(AVG(odor_score), 2) AS avgOdor FROM toilet_feedback
